description: Election Commission - Mr. K. I. Ifthikar was elected as the member of the ward No. 06 Palliady of Eravur Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Eravur Urban Council) due to the death of an elected member. It involves the nomination process by a recognized political party and the declaration of a new elected member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content falls squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected officials for local government positions.
